revision: plan v1 (18 Nov 2026) against spec revision 4
note: There is no endpoint and no event (Story RWB-E1-069 v1, section 12). The contracts below are the non-HTTP interfaces this story publishes or changes. No migration number is fixed: both files use V<seq> and the orchestrator assigns the next free four-digit numbers at merge (D-RUN-07, D-RCV-28); they are contiguous, Section A then Section B. Line 1 of each file is -- Story: RWB-E1-069.

contracts.seq: assigned at merge (D-RUN-07, D-RCV-28); no number in this plan
contentsInOrder: REVOKE ALL ON ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA ${recoverySchema} FROM PUBLIC, first, before any v_ace_* view exists (SPEC-004 step 1; REVOKE only, no GRANT on all tables)

three helper functions, CREATE OR REPLACE, LANGUAGE sql, IMMUTABLE: ace_to_boolean and ace_mask_value as ACE Source Views v1 lines 49-86; ace_to_date to the SPEC-002 behaviour table (not the source body, DG-L23)
REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION the three FROM PUBLIC, ace_view_owner
GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION the three TO recovery_svc
GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA ${recoverySchema} TO recovery_svc
GRANT USAGE, CREATE ON SCHEMA ${recoverySchema} TO ace_view_owner (transient)
16 Section A views, CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW, verbatim from ACE Source Views v1 lines 94-452 with recovery. changed to ${recoverySchema}.
per view: REVOKE ALL ON the view FROM PUBLIC, recovery_svc, ace_view_owner
per view: GRANT SELECT ON the view TO recovery_svc BEFORE the owner change
per view: ALTER VIEW the view OWNER TO ace_view_owner
REVOKE USAGE, CREATE ON SCHEMA ${recoverySchema} FROM ace_view_owner
contracts.migrationAccountRights: Exactly D-RUN-14: USAGE ON SCHEMA public with no table privilege, and ace_view_owner membership WITH INHERIT FALSE, SET TRUE. Delivered by RWB-E1-044 v14-7 local init; not restated here. No ACE DBA role, no SELECT on a public table, no SET ROLE, no GRANT to rwb_migrator.
forbidden: a literal recovery. or ace. qualifier

contracts.seq: next free four-digit number at its merge; later than the Section A file and contiguous with it (D-RUN-07)
contentsInOrder: 14 Section B views, verbatim from ACE Source Views v1 lines 461-711

grant block steps 5-11 of SPEC-004 for the 14 views: idempotent USAGE for recovery_svc; transient USAGE, CREATE for ace_view_owner; per-view REVOKE; GRANT SELECT before the owner change; ALTER VIEW OWNER TO ace_view_owner; final REVOKE
step 1 is omitted: the 16 Section A views are already owned by ace_view_owner and a schema-wide REVOKE would fail with permission denied for table v_ace_*
contracts.precondition: RWB-ACE-001 deployed in every environment main deploys to, with its grants (DL43, DG-L16, DG-L20, OI-069-D). Locally infra/postgres/schema/02-ace-tier2-probe.sql stands in (ASM-005).
forbidden: any grant on a Tier 2 table

contracts.objects: 30 views ${recoverySchema}.v_ace_* (Story RWB-E1-069 v1 section 11); security_invoker not set
rules: no constraint in recovery references another schema
contracts.fields: 304 fields, DF-ACE-001..304: Section A 177 (16 views), Section B 127 (14 views). Column lists are in plan/data-model.md section 1 and are cited from ACE Source Views v1, not copied into code.
contracts.dataClassification: Data Classification and Personal Data Inventory v4: 250 of the 304 DF-ACE fields are personal, 12 Restricted, 54 non-personal. The RWB-E1-001 seed marks 250 true and 54 false and 526 true in the whole dictionary under its protective union. Identity number exposed only as id_no_masked and id_no_last4; contact value in clear with a masked copy. Display masking RWB-E1-037; read audit RWB-E1-016.

grantees.ace_view_owner: Owns the 30 views; no USAGE or CREATE on schema recovery after each file; no EXECUTE on the helpers; no privilege on any other recovery relation. ACE-side: USAGE on public and SELECT on the 21 Tier 1 and, with RWB-ACE-001, the 14 Tier 2 tables, granted by the ACE DBA (precondition P4(d)), not by these files.
grantees.recovery_svc: USAGE on recovery; SELECT on each v_ace_* view; EXECUTE on the 3 helper functions; nothing in public; no write on a view.
grantees.PUBLIC: Nothing on recovery tables or views; no EXECUTE on the helpers; nothing on public (ACE DBA revoke, P4(d)).
grantees.migrationAccount: Exactly D-RUN-14: USAGE ON SCHEMA public with no table privilege (SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, TRUNCATE, REFERENCES, TRIGGER), and ace_view_owner membership WITH INHERIT FALSE, SET TRUE, ADMIN false; owns schema recovery or may grant CREATE on it (P4(c)). Never the ACE DBA role, SELECT on a public table, CREATE on public, or an inheriting membership. Delivered by RWB-E1-044 v14-7, asserted by T-044-17 and by conformance check 5; D-RUN-14 is the orchestrator's decision, its ratification open (OI-069-M, proposed OPEN-051) and no human approval is claimed. Who applies it in SIT, UAT and PROD stays RWB-E1-044 v14-7 OI-E044-I; OI-069-A carries P4(c)-(d) only.

shape.sectionA: list of the 16 Section A view names, story section 11 order
shape.sectionB: list of the 14 Section B view names

contracts.validation: both lists present; name pattern ^v_ace_[a-z0-9_]+$; unique across both; counts 16 and 14; migration-folder rules of SPEC-013 (every created v_ace_* listed, Section A set equals sectionA, Section B set equals sectionB when present, BND-6 allows all 30 in both states)
contracts.reader: plan/data-model.md section 6; SourceViews and SourceViewsReader in backend/src/test/java/th/co/scb/ace/demo/recovery/architecture/boundary
contracts.owner: RWB-E1-069 for this key only; the rest of the file and the loader belong to RWB-TE-001 (D-RCV-37) and are not changed

contracts.qualifierSeam: SEAM-E044-01 is code, not data: public is admitted only inside CREATE [OR REPLACE] VIEW ${recoverySchema}.v_ace_*
contracts.roleSeam: No SET ROLE and no role-membership grant appears in either file; GRANT ... TO rwb_migrator fails L-GRANT. The D-RUN-14 rights are RWB-E1-044 v14-7's local init, not this story's SQL.

contracts.text: Boundary rule BND-6 broken: <SimpleClassName> reads public.<table>. Read recovery.<view> instead.
contracts.viewResolution: derived table-to-view map from the view bodies: the view whose top-level FROM names the table, otherwise the views that JOIN it, joined with ' or '
contracts.fallback: Read a recovery.v_ace_* view instead. (derived, not in story section 14)
contracts.exemptions: information_schema. and pg_catalog. qualifiers; the literal 'public' used as a catalog filter value (PlatformInfoController). Detector (d) matches keywords case-insensitively and table identifiers in lower case or quoted, so JPQL entity names do not match.

contracts.behaviour: external: the four read-only checks against the given database, no fixture, no write, no check 5; otherwise Testcontainers postgres:16.16-alpine with checks 1-5 and the four failing fixtures. No credential in code, a fixture or a log line.
contracts.flywayMechanism: RecoveryFlywayTestSupport (test scope, same package as the package-private RecoveryFlywayConfig) clears initMethodName on the recoveryFlyway bean definition, so the test uses the real bean's Flyway configuration with a target and RecoveryFlywayConfig stays unchanged. The class is IT-only and outside the unit coverage bundle; no unit-coverage target is claimed for it (REVIEW-122).
